items.text: Alabama and Oklahoma held Republican Senate primaries: Barry Moore won Alabama's runoff, while Tom Hern won Oklahoma's crowded primary, both advancing to November.
Washington DC debuted ranked-choice voting in its Democratic primary, dramatically reshaping results and delaying the mayor's race outcome by hours as mail ballots were counted.
Michigan's Senate passed a state Voting Rights Act package, while Delaware advanced two voting-rights constitutional amendments — state-level VRA activity surging in response to federal court limits.
Georgia Republicans voted to ban QR codes on ballots after primary mishaps and then shelved redistricting in a special session despite a court order, leaving maps unresolved.
Ohio moved a voter photo-ID constitutional amendment to the November ballot, and the FBI searched an Ohio voting-rights organization — two major election-law developments in one week.
